column1: # The voice: what each sound is made of, for the formant synthesizer (synth.py and its ports).
# phone kind  f1   f2   f3   b1  b2  b3   ms  voiced  nf    nbw   namp  amp   f1b  f2b  f3b
# kind: vowel | diph (a diphthong glides to f1b f2b f3b) | nasal | liquid | glide | stop | fric | affr | asp
# f1..f3: the formant targets in Hz (a stop's are its locus, where the next vowel's formants start from);
# b1..b3 their bandwidths; ms the steady duration; nf/nbw/namp the frication noise's centre, bandwidth and level.
